column1: # clues.tsv for ft_ultimate_div_mod — hints only, never answers.

The quotient has to end up in the int a points to, and the remainder in the one b points to. But the instant you write the first result, the original value there is gone -- and you still need it for the other one. What should you do before that first write?
When a negative number is involved, what sign does the remainder take and which way does division round?
